prompt:
You are implementing a small JavaScript utility.

File: work/swe-03/debounce.js

The exported function `debounce(fn, wait)` must return a debounced version of `fn`:
- Rapid repeated calls within `wait` ms collapse into ONE call using the LAST arguments (no synchronous call).
- Calls separated by more than `wait` ms each fire normally.
- The debounced function must preserve `this` and forward all arguments to `fn`.
- The debounced function must expose a `.cancel()` method that drops any pending call.

Currently the stub calls `fn` immediately on every invocation (no debouncing at all).

Requirements:
- Use only built-in `setTimeout`/`clearTimeout`; no external dependencies.
- Keep `module.exports = { debounce }`.

Edit work/swe-03/debounce.js so the behavior above holds.
